cases.sentence: Так говорит Господь, храните правосудие и творите ___, потому что скоро придет спасение мое, и откроется моя правда.
cases.translation: This is what Yahweh says: maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.
cases.explain: The verb творите (practice/do) takes the accusative case for its direct object правду (righteousness).

cases.sentence: Блажен человек, поступающий так, крепко этого держащийся, хранящий субботу, не оскверняя ее, и удерживающий руку, чтобы не делать никакого ___.
cases.translation: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.
cases.explain: The phrase 'не делать никакого зла' (not to do any evil) uses the genitive case after the negative pronoun никакого.

cases.sentence: Пусть никто из чужеземцев, присоединившихся к Господу, не говорит Господь непременно отделит меня от своего ___.
cases.translation: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to Yahweh speak, saying, 'Yahweh will surely separate me from his people.'
cases.explain: The possessive phrase 'своего народа' (his people) uses the genitive case to show possession.

cases.sentence: Ведь так говорит Господь, Евнухом, хранящим мои субботы, избирающим то, что мне угодно, и крепко держащимся завета со ___.
cases.translation: For Yahweh says, 'To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) requires the instrumental case мною when referring to God.

cases.sentence: Я дам в моем храме и его стенах памятный знак и ___, и это будет лучше, чем иметь сыновей с дочерьми.
cases.translation: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters.
cases.explain: The verb дам (I will give) takes the accusative case for its direct object имя (name).

cases.sentence: А чужеземцев, присоединившимся к Господу, чтобы служить Ему, любить имя Господне и поклоняться Ему, всех хранящих субботу, не оскверняя ее, и крепко держащихся завета со мною, Я приведу на мою святую ___ и дарую им радость в моем доме молитвы.
cases.translation: Also the foreigners who join themselves to Yahweh to serve him, and to love Yahweh's name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant, I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer.
cases.explain: The verb приведу (I will bring) takes the accusative case for the destination гору (mountain).

cases.sentence: Их всесожжения и жертвы будут приняты на моем жертвеннике, потому что дом мой будет назван домом молитвы для всех ___.
cases.translation: Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
cases.explain: The phrase 'домом молитвы для всех народов' (a house of prayer for all peoples) uses the genitive plural народов after the preposition для.

cases.sentence: Так возвещает владыка Господь, собирающий изгнанников ___. Я соберу к ним еще и других, кроме тех, кто уже собран.
cases.translation: The Lord Yahweh, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, 'I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.'
cases.explain: The phrase 'изгнанников Израиля' (exiles of Israel) uses the genitive case to show possession.

reading.ru: Так говорит Господь, храните правосудие и творите правду, потому что скоро придет спасение мое, и откроется моя правда.
reading.question: What does the Lord command people to do, and why?
options: Maintain justice and do what is right, because salvation is near and righteousness will be revealed
reading.correct: Maintain justice and do what is right, because salvation is near and righteousness will be revealed
reading.explain: The verse says 'Yahweh says, Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.'

reading.ru: Блажен человек, поступающий так, крепко этого держащийся, хранящий субботу, не оскверняя ее, и удерживающий руку, чтобы не делать никакого зла.
reading.question: Who is blessed according to this verse?
options: The man who does this, holds fast to it, keeps the Sabbath, and refuses to do evil
A person who commits evil acts
reading.correct: The man who does this, holds fast to it, keeps the Sabbath, and refuses to do evil
reading.explain: The verse states 'Blessed is the man who does this, and holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.'

reading.ru: Я дам в моем храме и его стенах памятный знак и имя, и это будет лучше, чем иметь сыновей с дочерьми.
reading.question: What does God promise to give, and how is it better than having children?
options: A memorial and an everlasting name, which is better than having sons and daughters
reading.correct: A memorial and an everlasting name, which is better than having sons and daughters
reading.explain: The text says 'I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters.'

reading.ru: Я приведу на мою святую гору и дарую им радость в моем доме молитвы.
reading.question: What will God do for the foreigners who keep his covenant?
options: Bring them to his holy mountain and grant them joy in his house of prayer
Reject them and cast them out
reading.correct: Bring them to his holy mountain and grant them joy in his house of prayer
reading.explain: The verse states 'I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer.'

reading.ru: Их всесожжения и жертвы будут приняты на моем жертвеннике, потому что дом мой будет назван домом молитвы для всех народов.
reading.question: Why will the offerings of the foreigners be accepted on God's altar?
options: Because God's house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples
Because they are wealthier than others
Because they have no other place to worship
reading.correct: Because God's house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples
reading.explain: The text says 'Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.'

reading.ru: Так возвещает владыка Господь, собирающий изгнанников Израиля. Я соберу к ним еще и других, кроме тех, кто уже собран.
reading.question: What does the Lord promise regarding the gathering of Israel's exiles?
options: The Lord will gather the outcasts of Israel and will also gather others besides those already gathered
The outcasts will never be gathered again
Only some of the exiles will be allowed to return
The Lord will abandon the exiles forever
reading.correct: The Lord will gather the outcasts of Israel and will also gather others besides those already gathered
reading.explain: The verse states 'The Lord Yahweh, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, I will yet gather others to him.'
